Package dev.turboism.sdk.hostread

Interface AsyncHostReadHandle

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
public interface AsyncHostReadHandle extends AutoCloseable
A plugin-owned view of one admitted asynchronous host read.

The handle is owned by the service that returned it. Closing it is equivalent to requesting cancellation; it does not close the shared host-read lane. Handles are invalid only by their terminal state, and cancellation is best-effort for work already executing.

    • cancel

      boolean cancel()
      Requests cancellation of this read.

      A successful request settles the completion as AsyncHostReadStatus.CANCELED. Cancellation can remove queued work or interrupt runtime-owned work, but cannot undo a host read that has already happened.

      Returns:
      true only when this invocation changed a non-terminal read to canceled

    • completion

      CompletionStage<AsyncHostReadResult> completion()
      Returns the single terminal result stage.

      The stage completes normally with a structured success, failure, timeout, or cancellation result. The runtime dispatches settlement and dependent callbacks through the owning plugin's bounded executor rather than the shared host-read worker; callers that use async stage methods with an explicit executor choose their own callback location.

      Returns:
      a stage for the terminal result
